title: Juz' Tabarak revision check: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 10 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Juz' Tabarak revision check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 10. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ (١) ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ (٢)

keywords.def: the 29th part of the Qur'an, surahs 67 to 77

questions.q: Read 67:3 and say what the ۖ sign tells you about stopping after طِبَاقًۭا.
questions.a: ۖ: continuing is better; if joined, طِبَاقًۭا مَّا is idgham with ghunnah.

questions.q: Revision check: today's rota group recites Al-Mulk 67:1 to 10 (or their placement surah) to the teacher. Everyone else revises in breakout pairs with the rubric.
Extend: write the eleven surahs in order from memory.
questions.a: Al-Mulk, Al-Qalam, Al-Haqqah, Al-Ma'arij, Nuh, Al-Jinn, Al-Muzzammil, Al-Muddaththir, Al-Qiyamah, Al-Insan, Al-Mursalat.

questions.q: Stretch: recite the first ayah of each surah 67 to 77.

questions.a: A) Nuh. 71 is Nuh; 70 Al-Ma'arij; 72 Al-Jinn.

questions.q: Juz' Tabarak has how many surahs?
Think again: Juz' Tabarak was a Year 8 and 9 target. If some of it has faded, is that failure, or information?
questions.a: Information: the check shows exactly what to revise; fading is normal without a rota.
